title: Bug: Config.set() mutates DEFAULTS globally and get() with a missing key raises instead of returning the fallback
body:
## Bug Report
**File:** `src/config_loader.py`

`Config.set()` writes into the shared `DEFAULTS` dict, so two `Config` instances leak values into each other. `get(key, default)` raises `KeyError` instead of returning `default` when the key is missing.
### Expected
- instances have independent overrides
- `get('missing', 'fb') == 'fb'`
